title: The Tin Dragon's Apprentice
author: Corwen Pell
tagline: A canal mechanic's daughter wakes the dragon that warms her city.
description: Sixteen-year-old Odile Marchetti knows boilers, barges and a good wrench, so she is baffled to become apprentice to the Dragon-Warden of Gantry. Old Ferrous, the tin dragon that heats the city, is stirring, and it will only talk to her. With coal running short, someone has plans for it.
authorBio: Corwen Pell writes adventure stories about engines, weather and stubborn people. He lives beside a tidal river, where he mends his own bicycle badly and his own sentences slowly.
contentNotes: Peril, a flood, and mild cold-related illness.
